component.description: Self Destruct Unit

component.name: PowerBolt
component.description: The PowerBolt provides all the power and performance you need for your journey through the stars. You can trust Lightning Power to get you there.

component.name: ArcticStorm
component.description: If you’re after a cooler that balances performance, durability and stealth, then look to the ArcticStorm. This mid-grade cooler from Lightning Power Ltd uses their centuries old technology to provide performance that can be relied upon.

component.name: WEB
component.description: Tried, tested, and refined for centuries, the WEB shield generator balances sleek design with stellar performance to keep your ship safe under a wide variety of circumstances.

component.name: Capston
component.description: Experience why WillsOp is a premiere manufacturer of ship electronics with their Capston radar. Outfit your ship with one today so you know what’s nearby.

component.name: Eos
component.description: The Eos quantum drive has been a staple in the RSI product line for centuries. Its original design was so perfectly fine-tuned that it has remained basically unchanged since.

component.name: Explorer
component.description: Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Explorer jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

component.name: MSD-221 Missile Rack
component.description: Behring’s MSD-221 "Marsden" is a complete ordnance storage and deployment system that can be mounted on any compatible size 2 hardpoint for the reliable and effective launch of two S1 missiles.

component.name: Marksman I Missile
component.description: Behring's Marksman series of proximity missiles has earned as much of a reputation for its ability to track a wide range of heat signatures as it has for its area-effect proximity damage.

component.name: VariPuck S2 Gimbal Mount
component.description: The VariPuck fits between your weapon and the ship hardpoint to transform a fixed weapon mount into a gimballed mount, allowing the pilot to independently aim their weapon’s fire. VariPucks will accept any weapon the same size as the hardpoint it is mounting to.

component.name: Snapper S2 Repeater
component.description: With its rapid rate of fire and high-intensity heat per blast, the Snapper laser repeater builds on the standards of its kind and improves on them with its combination of components from a range of other guns.

component.description: Created from a mixture of different parts, the Deathroll gatling gun can rapidly fire across a long range. Though it requires ammunition, the explosive power each shot contains more than makes up for the cost of ammo.

component.name: Basher Chopper Bodykit Top
component.description: The quickest, surefire way to let everyone who sees you know that you're no one to mess with - the Chopper Bodykit gives the top of your ship a dramatic edge without sacrificing aerodynamics. With this giant steel-plated mast on, you won't just turn heads; your enemies will turn tail on your approach too.

component.name: ComfortAir
component.description: Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.
